vectors.edit: control: the behaviour passes and every probe passes
the behaviour passes and a second run of the visible test gives another answer
the behaviour passes and the visible test fails when its arguments keep their exact types
the behaviour passes and importing the module under test changes what the test runner reads
the behaviour passes and a probe outran its limit: it gave no answer
the held-out test fails and the visible test passes, so a visible probe still counts and its failure contradicts
the behaviour fails, and the import probe failed on its own comparison: it reads no answer, so it counts and names the import's effect
control: the behaviour fails and the import probe failed because the module raised on import, which an honest module can do
control: the same failure with no failure kind recorded
control: the behaviour fails and a probe that compares answers fails too; it cannot fail more than the wrong answer already did
control: the isolated run and its in-process twin both pass
the isolated run fails on an assertion and the in-process twin exits zero: the candidate changed how its own process reports failure
the isolated run fails because the candidate ended its own process, and the twin exits zero
control: the isolated run fails on an error the isolation itself can cause, and the twin passes: an honest divergence
control: the isolated run fails with no failure kind recorded
control: the isolated run fails on an assertion and the twin fails as well
control: the isolated run was stopped at its limit, so its failure says nothing about the candidate's exit
a detector refuses: the candidate takes a branch only the visible test's inputs reach
a detector refuses: the candidate's answer on the visible inputs depends on state outside its arguments
a detector refuses: the candidate answers the visible inputs only for their exact types
a detector refuses: the candidate gives the visible test another answer when it is run again
control: a measured finding that the test author made the visible test unsatisfiable travels as evidence and never refuses
control: the detectors ran and found nothing
